The FloPlast 68mm round downpipe shoe is a robust uPVC component designed for efficient rainwater drainage, effectively redirecting water away from building foundations. This black downpipe fitting offers a practical solution for both new-build projects and refurbishment applications. Manufactured from durable uPVC, it features a single socket for straightforward installation and requires no lubrication, enhancing on-site efficiency for plumbing and roofing professionals. Its good flow capacity ensures effective water management, making it a reliable choice for completing any rainwater system.
